card.name: Everyday stock phrases like "of course"
card.fires_on: The last word or an inner word of short stock phrases in general web prose, such as "course" in "of course", "ease" in "with ease", and "some" in "in some areas". It also fires on small words like "than", "enough" and "against" inside set phrases.

modes.label: Small words inside set phrases
